ExpeditionGetoPhase1.Description: Every $SpawnInterval seconds, summon between three monsters, each having different mechanics

ExpeditionFlowerBoss.Description: Permanently holds an archetype resistance, cycling between $Physical and $Magical upon each skull consumed. Upon losing a skull it splits into two, halving its health and attack damage each time, while gaining increased regeneration and a stacking modifier; $Reinforced, $Soldier, then $Veil.

ExpeditionGetoPhase2.Description: Enter a phase when hitting $Health_Trigger% Health, which gains resistance, starts a countdown & summon all of his monsters. If defeated within the countdown, the enemy gets weakened, otherwise, absorb the monsters and heal based off their health

ExpeditionCellBoss.Description: Immune to damage, and spawns jrs where every $KillThreshold took down, take $ThresholdDamagePercent% damage. Upon reaching $Health_Trigger% health, he stops for a few seconds & all jrs are despawned, then he and his jrs gain modifiers.

ExpeditionDressrosaBoss.Description: Every $StringInterval seconds, attach a string onto a random unit, stunning them if they kill too many enemies; when Doffy reaches $Health_Trigger% health, he raises $PillarCount pillars around the Payload that slow it by $PillarSlow% each and make him invincible until all pillars are destroyed.
